capture.announce: 🔴 Recording **{channel}** to take meeting notes. Use `/meeting stop` to stop the recording.
capture.busy: I'm already in another voice channel in this server. Remove me with `/voice leave`, then start the recording again.
capture.discord_only: Live recording works only from Discord.
capture.ffmpeg_missing: I can't record right now: the bot's installation is missing a component. Ask an administrator to run `hermes meeting-scribe doctor`.
capture.incompatible: Recording isn't available with the current version of the bot. Ask an administrator to run `hermes meeting-scribe doctor`.
capture.join_voice_first: Join a voice channel first, or pass one: `/meeting start #voice-channel`.
capture.no_guild: Run this inside a Discord server channel (not a DM).
capture.not_connected: The bot is still connecting to Discord; try again in a moment.
capture.reason_disconnected: the connection to the voice channel was lost
capture.reason_shutdown: the bot is shutting down or restarting
capture.started: 🔴 Recording **{channel}** — meeting `{id}`. Use `/meeting stop` to finish.
capture.stop_empty: ⏹️ Recording stopped. No audio was captured; there are no notes to prepare (meeting `{id}`).
capture.stop_ok: ⏹️ Recording stopped. I'm preparing the notes for meeting `{id}`; they will be posted as soon as they're ready.
capture.stopped: ⏹️ Recording stopped ({reason}). I'm preparing the notes for meeting `{id}`; they will be posted as soon as they're ready.
capture.stopped_empty: ⏹️ Recording stopped ({reason}). No audio was captured; there are no notes to prepare (meeting `{id}`).
capture.target_not_found: No voice channel “{target}” in this server.
capture.timeout: Discord took too long to answer; check `/meeting status` to see how the recording ended up.

cli.llm_default: {keys}: using the default value (Hermes keeps no explicit copy of a default).
cli.llm_no_fallback: no fallback chain: if the provider fails (no credit, rate limit), analysis retries later. Add one: hermes meeting-scribe llm fallback add <provider>:<model>
cli.llm_unavailable: Hermes' configuration is not available in this runtime.
cli.meet_channel_missing: ⚠️ Google Meet import is on but no notes channel is set: notes go to the server's system channel or a channel named like delivery_auto_channel_names (#general, #meetings…); if none exists they wait. Set google_meet_discord_channel (a channel name or id) to choose one.
cli.setup_google: Google Meet import: enable it now? You will need an OAuth client JSON (see README → Google Meet) [y/N]:
cli.setup_intro: meeting-scribe setup — press Enter to keep the value in brackets.
cli.setup_language_hint: Pinning the spoken language is strongly recommended: auto-detect can flip mid-meeting.
cli.waiting_retried: {count} delivery(ies) waiting for a channel will be retried now by the gateway.
cmd.capture_unavailable: Live recording isn't available in this installation. You can still browse, search and reprocess meetings.
cmd.error: The command could not be completed. Try again in a moment and, if it keeps failing, tell an administrator.
cmd.help:
**/{cmd}** — meeting notes
`start [#voice]` start recording · `stop` stop recording · `status` what's going on · `list [n]` latest meetings · `show <id>` a meeting's notes · `search <text>` search what was said · `reprocess <id> [from=transcribe|analyze|deliver]` redo a meeting (from the audio, only the notes, or only post them again) · `link @user <Linear email or name>` · `project <id> <project>` · `config` settings · `help`
cmd.project_saved: Meeting `{id}` assigned to project “{project}”; future meetings in this channel will use that project.
cmd.project_unknown: I don't know the project “{project}”. Available: {candidates}
cmd.reprocess_bad_stage: I don't recognise `{stage}`. Use `from=transcribe` (start again from the audio), `from=analyze` (regenerate the notes) or `from=deliver` (post the notes again).
cmd.reprocess_dm_how: The notes of this meeting were posted in a direct message. Use `from=deliver` to move them to the notes channel.
cmd.reprocess_dm_moving: The notes of this meeting were posted in a direct message; they will be moved to the notes channel if an administrator has chosen one.
cmd.reprocess_empty: Meeting `{id}` has no audio (nobody was heard), so there is nothing to reprocess.
cmd.reprocess_no_audio: This meeting was imported without audio: its notes will be regenerated from its transcript.
cmd.reprocess_queued: Meeting `{id}`: {stage}. The notes will be updated when it's done.
cmd.status_failed_extra: — couldn't finish ({stage}). Try `reprocess`, or ask an administrator to check `hermes meeting-scribe status`.
cmd.status_idle: Not recording right now. Meetings waiting to be processed: {queued}.
cmd.status_waiting_channel: — waiting for a channel to post the notes in; an administrator needs to choose one.
doctor.llm_no_fallback: no fallback chain for meeting analysis: add one with `hermes meeting-scribe llm fallback add <provider>:<model>`
google.connect_intro: Open this URL in a browser signed in to your Google Workspace account and grant read access to Meet:
google.connect_paste: After consenting, paste the full URL of the page you were redirected to (it may fail to load; that is fine) or just the code:
google.connect_waiting: Waiting for the browser redirect (up to {minutes} min)...
google.connected: ✅ Google connected. New Meet transcripts ending after now will be imported{extra}.
google.enable_hint: once you run `hermes meeting-scribe config set google_meet_enabled true` (and restart the gateway)
google.no_client: Google: no OAuth client stored. Pass --client-secret <file.json> (Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client, type Desktop app).
google.not_connected: Google: not connected. Run `hermes meeting-scribe google connect --client-secret <file.json>`.
google.reconnected: ✅ Google reconnected. Meet transcripts ending after the first connection ({since}, at most 30 days back) that are not imported yet will be imported{extra}.
google.revoke_failed: ⚠️ Could not revoke the access at Google (network or Google error). The local token is deleted, but the grant may still be active: remove it at {url}
google.status_connected: Google: connected (scope meetings.space.readonly; the account is not read).
google.status_disconnected: Google: disconnected — access was revoked or expired. Run `hermes meeting-scribe google connect` again.
google.sync_report: Listed {listed} conference(s): {imported} imported, {already} already imported, {pending} transcript(s) not ready yet, {none} without transcript.
notes.partial: Recording was interrupted; notes may be incomplete.
sink.linear_inactive: Linear is not connected (no LINEAR_API_KEY and no allowlisted `linear` MCP server).
stage.analyze.label: writing the notes
stage.analyze.redo: regenerating the notes from the transcript
stage.archive.label: archiving
stage.deliver.label: posting the notes
stage.transcribe.label: transcribing
tasks.dm_failed: Could not send a direct message to {users} (their DMs are closed); they can see their tasks with 📋 My tasks.
tasks.kanban_owner_tasks: The Kanban button only appears on the board owners' own tasks.
tasks.legacy_moved: ↪️ These tasks moved to their project threads; see the task index.
tasks.moved: Moved to {channel}; future “{project}” tasks will go there too.
tasks.no_permission: I'm not allowed to post in {channel}; the tasks are here
tasks.owners_only_unassigned: This task has no assignee; only owners can act on it.
tasks.panel_empty: You have no tasks in this meeting.
tasks.uncertain: project to be confirmed — use 📁 Move
tasks.unknown: That task was not found; the meeting notes may have been updated.
transcript.no_permission: 📎 I couldn't attach the full transcript: I'm missing the **Attach Files** permission in this channel. An administrator can get it with `hermes meeting-scribe export`.
transcript.title: Transcript — {title}
transcript.too_large: 📎 The transcript is too long to attach here ({parts} parts). An administrator can get it with `hermes meeting-scribe export`.
ui.action_failed: That action could not be completed. Try again in a moment and, if it keeps failing, tell an administrator.
ui.approved_partial: {failed} task(s) could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
ui.error_channel_unavailable: I can't post in that channel. Pick another one.
ui.error_dismissed: This task was dismissed, so it can't be sent.
ui.error_not_found: I couldn't find that meeting, task or project; the notes may have been updated.
ui.error_notes_not_ready: The notes of this meeting aren't ready yet. Try again in a few minutes.
ui.error_sink_unavailable: {sink} isn't connected right now. Ask an administrator.
ui.no_projects: No projects available to choose from.
ui.not_allowed: You are not allowed to use these buttons.
ui.owner_only: Only meeting owners can send tasks to Kanban.
ui.pick_project: Pick the project for this meeting:
ui.project_saved: Project set to “{project}”; this channel will default to it from now on.
space.choose: This installation has several spaces: run the command inside a Discord server of the space you want.
space.unassigned: This Discord server belongs to no space, so nothing is recorded or shown here. An administrator can add it to a space.
capture.unassigned: This Discord server belongs to no space, so it is not recorded. An administrator can add it to a space.
space.choose_none: This bot serves several teams, and I cannot tell which ones you belong to from a private message. Run the command inside your team's Discord server instead.
space.not_yours: I don't know the team “{slug}”, or you are not part of it. Teams you can use: {spaces}.
space.here_only: In this server I only use its own team's meetings; `space=` works in private messages.
capture.other_channel: I'm already recording **{channel}** in this server (meeting `{id}`). I can only be in one voice channel per server, so stop that recording first with `/meeting stop` if you want to record another channel.
space.cli_required: This installation has several spaces: add --space <slug> ({spaces}).
space.cli_global_key: {key} is a machine-wide setting and cannot differ per space; set it without --space: hermes meeting-scribe config set {key} <value>
space.cli_overrides: Overrides (the rest comes from the global settings):
space.cli_no_overrides: No overrides: every setting comes from the global settings.
space.cli_created: Space {slug} created ({name}). Assign a Discord server with: hermes meeting-scribe space add-guild {slug} <server-id>
space.cli_guild_removed: Server {guild} removed from space {slug}; nothing is recorded there until it is assigned again.
space.cli_unassigned_guild: the bot is in server {guild}, which belongs to no space: nothing is recorded there (hermes meeting-scribe space add-guild <slug> <id>).
